strategies.name: SPY Buy and Hold
strategies.summary: Buys SPY on the first day and holds it to the end. This is the benchmark the other strategies are compared against.
strategies.entry_rules: Long on every bar, starting from the first bar.
strategies.exit_rules: Never sells, except at the end of the test.
strategies.weaknesses: Takes the full market drop with no protection. Only runs on SPY.

strategies.name: EMA Cross
strategies.summary: Goes long when a fast moving average rises above a slow one, and short when it falls below.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when EMA(9) is above EMA(21). Short when EMA(9) is below EMA(21).
strategies.exit_rules: The position flips when the averages cross back.
strategies.weaknesses: Whipsaws in sideways markets. Lags after sharp moves.

strategies.name: RSI Reversion
strategies.summary: Buys after RSI shows a stock has fallen too far too fast, and sells once it recovers to the middle. Shorts the opposite when RSI is stretched high.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when RSI(14) closes below 30. Short when RSI(14) closes above 70.
strategies.exit_rules: Close a long when RSI rises above 50. Close a short when RSI falls below 50.
strategies.weaknesses: Strong trends keep RSI pinned high or low, so it can enter early and keep losing. Slow to exit after a sharp reversal.

strategies.name: Donchian Breakout
strategies.summary: Buys when price breaks above its highest high of the last 20 days, and goes short when it breaks below the lowest low.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close is above the highest high of the previous 20 bars. Short when the close is below the lowest low of the previous 20 bars.
strategies.exit_rules: Close a long when the close drops below the lowest low of the previous 10 bars. Close a short when the close rises above the highest high of the previous 10 bars.
strategies.weaknesses: Sideways markets trigger false breakouts and repeated small losses.

strategies.name: 200-Day Trend
strategies.summary: Holds the stock while it trades above its 200-day average, and stays in cash while it trades below.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close is above the 200-day simple moving average.
strategies.exit_rules: Sell when the close falls below the 200-day simple moving average.
strategies.weaknesses: Slow to get out after a crash and slow to get back in. Gets whipsawed when price hovers around the average.

strategies.name: Bollinger Reversion
strategies.summary: Buys when a stock drops well below its recent average, and sells once it climbs back to that average.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close falls below the 20-day average minus 2 standard deviations. Long only.
strategies.exit_rules: Sell when the close rises back above the 20-day average. Also sells at a 5% stop-loss below the entry price.
strategies.weaknesses: In a steady downtrend, price keeps falling below the band. The stop limits the loss but also cuts some recoveries short.

strategies.name: 6-Month Momentum
strategies.summary: Goes long a stock that is higher than it was about six months ago, and short one that is lower.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close is above the close 126 bars (about 6 months) ago. Short when it is below.
strategies.exit_rules: The position flips when the sign of that comparison changes.
strategies.weaknesses: Trend reversals cause repeated losses. Sharp rallies hurt the short side badly.

strategies.name: RSI(2) Pullback
strategies.summary: Buys a short dip in an uptrend, once the stock is very oversold for a day or two, and sells on the bounce.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close is above the 200-day average and the 2-day RSI is below 10. Long only.
strategies.exit_rules: Sell when the close is above the 5-day average.
strategies.weaknesses: Pullbacks in a bear market can turn into long declines. Works best on stocks that bounce quickly.
